item.title: Gold Coast Dredging Project Births a Brand New Wave
item.description: In his latest video, Dylan Graves documents his pursuit of a break birthed by a dredging project on the Gold Coast in the wake of Cyclone Alfred.

item.title: Finders Keepers: Tanner Gudauskas Examines ‘Shelter’s’ Green Bonzer Experiment
item.description: In "Finders Keepers," Tanner Gudauskas explores the history of the green bonzer surfboard from the movie "Shelter," and its impact on surf culture.

item.title: Will The Eddie Go This Year? Competitors Weigh in On the Fickle Nature of Waimea Bay
item.description: Will the Eddie Aikau Big Wave Invitational run for a record third year straight? We asked competitors for predictions on whether the "Bay will call the day."

item.title: Carissa Moore Drops Monster Scores at Haleiwa Pro In First Heats Back After Hiatus
item.description: Carissa Moore's first three heats after a two-year hiatus from the WSL, and year and a half since the Paris Olympics, saw her post an 18.10, 17.03, and 16.6.

item.title: Earthquake Hits Japan; Evacuation Orders in Place as Tsunami Warnings Issued
item.description: Nearly 90,000 residents have been ordered to evacuate after Japan was hit by a major earthquake that prompted tsunami warnings.

item.title: 4 Tourists Dead, 1 Missing After Wave Swept Them Out to Sea In Tenerife
item.description: On Sunday, strong waves swept away tourists at a popular Tenerife tourist destination.

item.title: Hawaii’s Kīlauea Volcano Erupted In an Astonishing Show of Mother Nature’s Power
item.description: Hawaii's Kīlauea volcano spectacular eruption shot fountains of lava over a thousand feet in the air and even destroyed one of the USGS's live-feed cameras.

item.title: 5 Minutes With Irish Surf Photographer Conor Flanagan
item.description: Conor Flanagan has made a life for himself as a surf photographer in the Atlantic Ocean's most inhospitable waters. Ireland is no joke.

item.title: Blair Conklin Dislocated His Shoulder Again and Tried to Fix It on the Beach
item.description: Blair Conklin is no stranger to injuries. Recently, he dislocated his shoulder while riding some backwashy waves that were super fun... until they weren't.

item.title: Watch a Young Skier Narrowly Dodge Three Deer Racing Across Trail
item.description: One near collision at Deer Valley had no room for right-of-way discussions, mainly because the culprits downhill wouldn't stick around to hash things out
